events.title: Australian Dollar Falls Against Majors
events.description: The Australian dollar weakened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Thursday.

events.title: European Shares Expected To Open On Tepid Note
events.description: European stocks are seen opening on a subdued note on Thursday as investors ponder the outlook for inflation and interest rates amid escalating West Asia conflict.

events.title: Indian Shares Sharply Higher As Oil Prices Fall
events.description: Indian shares were sharply higher in early trade on Thursday as Brent crude futures fell nearly 2 percent toward $104 a barrel on reports that the Trump administration is considering easing sanctions on so-called shadow fleet vessels in order to reduce record-high global freight rates.

events.title: Australian Market Trims Early Losses In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian market is trimming its early losses in mid-market moves on Thursday, but extending the losses in the previous session, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 is falling well below the 8,750 level, with weakness in mining and technology stocks partially offset by gains in energy and financial stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets A Sea Of Red
events.description: Asian stock markets are a sea of red on Thursday, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight, after hotter-than-expected U.S. inflation data revived bets on interest rate hikes by the US Fed that prompted a sell-off in technology and semiconductor stocks on concerns of rising borrowing costs amid heightening investments in artificial intelligence.

events.title: Indian Shares Seen Flat To Lower At Open
events.description: Indian shares may drift lower at open on Thursday, although information technology stocks may extend recent gains after a gauge of semiconductor stocks extended losses into a sixth day on concerns about the sustainability of the artificial-intelligence trade.

events.title: Thai Shares Likely To Remain Rangebound
events.description: The Thai stock market has alternated between positive and negative finishes through the last four trading days since the end of the five-day winning streak in which it had gained almost 25 points or 1.6 percent. The Stock Exchange of Thailand now sits just above the 1,575-point plateau and it's likely to tick lower again on Thursday.

events.title: Lower Open Called For Indonesia Stock Market
events.description: The Indonesia stock market on Wednesday ended the two-day slide in which it had dropped almost 170 points or 2.9 percent. The Jakarta Composite Index now sits just above the 5,940-point plateau although it's likely to open in the red on Thursday.

events.title: Japanese Market Sharply Lower
events.description: The Japanese market is trading sharply lower on Thursday, extending the losses in the previous five sessions, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight. The Nikkei 225 is falling well below the 65,200 level, with weakness across most sectors led by index heavyweights and technology stocks.

events.title: Hong Kong Stock Market Tipped To Open Under Pressure On Thursday
events.description: The Hong Kong stock market on Wednesday halted the three-day winning streak in which it had advanced almost 575 points or 2 percent. The Hang Seng now sits just above the 24,310-point plateau and it may see continued consolidation on Thursday.

events.title: China Bourse May Extend Wednesday's Losses
events.description: The China stock market has alternated between positive and negative finishes through the last five trading days since the end of the two-day winning streak in which it had collected almost 20 points or 0.5 percent. The Shanghai Composite Index now sits just beneath the 3,770-point plateau and it may take further damage on Thursday.

events.title: Australian Market Notably Lower
events.description: The Australian market is trading notably lower on Thursday, extending the losses in the previous session, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 is falling well below the 8,700 level, with weakness in mining and technology stocks partially offset by gains in energy and financial stocks.

events.title: Australia Jobless Rate 4.7% In September
events.description: Australia posted a seasonally adjusted unemployment rate of 4.7 percent in September, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Thursday.
